description: This file implements dependency injection for MCP (Model Control Plane) in the Superset project, providing concrete decorators for tools and prompts, and initializing these in the core MCP module.

methods.name: create_tool_decorator
methods.description: Creates a decorator for registering MCP tools with optional authentication.

methods.name: create_prompt_decorator
methods.description: Creates a decorator for registering MCP prompts with optional authentication.

methods.name: initialize_core_mcp_dependencies
methods.description: Replaces abstract MCP decorators in the core module with concrete implementations.
